import React, { useCallback, type ReactNode } from "react"; interface Item { id: number; label: string; } type Props = { title: string; items: readonly Item[]; children?: ReactNode; onPick?: (item: Item) => void; }; const identity = <T,>(value: T): T => value; export function Panel({ title, items, children, onPick }: Props) { const pick = useCallback( (item: Item) => onPick?.(item), [onPick] ); return ( <section className="panel"> <h2>{title}</h2> <ul> {items.map((item) => ( <li key={item.id} onClick={() => pick(item)}> {item.label as string} </li> ))} </ul> {children} </section> ); } export default function App(): JSX.Element { const items = identity<Item[]>([{ id: 1, label: "one" }]); return <Panel title="Things" items={items} />; }
